packageRules.description: Plugins pinned to a branch commit (git-refs): the shared preset holds every git-refs update for review; here they come in one PR a week, opened on Saturday or Sunday like the preset's weekly groups, instead of one per upstream commit.

customManagers.description: ARGs pinned to a branch's commit SHA: currentValue names the branch, the git-refs datasource proposes its new HEAD as a digest update. The preset's Dockerfile manager (customManagers:dockerfileVersions) reads the other '# renovate:' ARGs; it skips these, whose comment carries currentValue=.
